clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, Renferrel's Findings carry research south to Tarren Mill. Apothecary Renferrel gathered the notes at the Sepulcher for Apothecary Lydon, who is helping brew the Forsaken's New Plague.

At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel records his work on the New Plague. The Royal Apothecary Society labours under direct orders from Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Dark Lady. Researchers scattered across Lordaeron must work together to achieve a breakthrough. Renferrel sends his findings south to Tarren Mill, where fellow researchers can build on his results.

The papers link Silverpine Forest to Hillsbrad Foothills and the Forsaken's alchemical network. Apothecary Lydon awaits Renferrel's notes in Tarren Mill, where he can compare them with his own work against the living and the Scourge. Reliable couriers must cross Hillsbrad's contested roads; without them, the Society's scattered research would quickly stall.
